rows.label: Validate — Check that a plugin / marketplace / component is well-formed
Fix — Auto-fix issues that a previous validation found
Optimize for Cache — Prompt-cache invalidation audit + cache-aware refactor (CA-01..CA-07)
Diagnose — Deep audit + AI-graded quality review (semantic, opus, on request)
Update — Upgrade plugin to latest canonical pipeline standard
Create — Scaffold plugin, marketplace, skill, agent, command, hook, MCP server
Publish & Migrate — Branch rules, link to marketplace, publish, migrate marketplace
Manage — List installed plugins, install / update / enable / disable / doctor
Help / About — Show the menu overview, list of commands, version
Ask the agent — Let the agent suggest the best next action right now
Cancel / Exit — Stop without doing anything
